text: {"components": [{"type": "obligation", "quote": "the applicant prepares at least two corridors in the planning zone and submits the necessary documentation to the SFOE", "gist": "Applicant must prepare two corridors and submit documentation to SFOE"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The latter then submits the documentation to the support group and may arrange for an on-site visit by the support group", "gist": "SFOE must submit documentation to support group and may arrange site visit"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The support group assesses the proposed corridors and recommends a planning corridor to the SFOE, together with the type of transmission technology to be used", "gist": "Support group must assess corridors and recommend a planning corridor and transmission technology to SFOE"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "In its assessment it takes the spatial and environmental impacts into account, as well as technical aspects and the question of economic viability", "gist": "Assessment must consider spatial, environmental, technical, and economic factors"}]}
